proof_body:
by
  intro p q d e x _ _ hx1 hx2 y
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := hx1
  obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := hx2
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
    rw [Int.coe_lcm]
    apply lcm_dvd
    · exact ⟨i - i0, by rw [hi, hi0]; ring⟩
    · exact ⟨j - j0, by rw [hj, hj0]; ring⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (Int.dvd_lcm_left d e).trans h
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (Int.dvd_lcm_right d e).trans h
    exact ⟨⟨i0 + s, by linarith [mul_add d i0 s]⟩, ⟨j0 + t, by linarith [mul_add e j0 t]⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (p q d e x : ℤ), 0 < d → 0 < e → (∃ i : ℤ, x = p + d * i) → (∃ j : ℤ, x = q + e * j) → ∀ y : ℤ, ((∃ i : ℤ, y = p + d * i) ∧ (∃ j : ℤ, y = q + e * j)) ↔ ((Int.lcm d e : ℤ) ∣ y - x)
